contract.takeaway: He has number ones in six separate categories, leading each.

claims.text: Eleven number ones as a lead single.
Nine as an album, four as a guest, three as a mixtape, two as a joint album, one as a compilation.

requiredMedia.contentRequirement: Six categories with their counts, arranged so the breadth across categories is the visible point rather than any single number.
